question: What was the percentage of India's population that belonged to the Muslim religion in 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**14.2%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Muslims as per 2011 Census:-**

 
 
• It indicates that only 0.142% of India's population identified themselves as Muslims in 2011.
 
• This figure is notably lower than some of the other large Muslim-majority countries in the world, such as Indonesia, Pakistan, and Bangladesh.
 
• The Muslim population in India has increased since 2011, but it is still a minority religion in the country.
 
• It is important to note that religion is a sensitive topic in India, and there have been instances of communal tensions and violence between different religious groups.
